items.q: because we had George ________ was on that show and Morris Loudon and Charlie Van Tour. I had the reed section open with him

ctx.x: Well, what did the show do? Did you sort of have a history of jazz, or what?

Yeah, we was playing concerts. Like, Jack Teagarden would play his trombone and he would do three or four numbers and sing. But I had it fixed so when he played, when he come out, I would have the reed section, because we had George ________ was on that show and Morris Loudon and Charlie Van Tour. I had the reed section open with him, just the opening number, one number. Then they'd disappear and he'd have it with the rhythm section.
